title: agentic-cli .agenticrc.toml
description: Per-project configuration for the agentic CLI. See docs/02-config.md for the full reference.

root.description: Stop the upward directory walk at this file.

namespace.description: Image namespace. Images are named <namespace>-<tool>. Allows multiple image sets per tool. Default: agentic.

docker_context.description: Docker context to use for this project.

build.description: Settings applied at `agentic build` / `agentic update` time.

bases.description: Extra runtime layers to add on top of the debian base (e.g. ["java", "dotnet"]). Accumulates across RC layers and with --base; --base-exact replaces it entirely instead.

apt_packages.description: Extra Debian packages to install in the base image. Accumulates across RC layers and with --apt; --apt-exact replaces it entirely instead.

versions.description: Per-layer version pins, written as [build.versions] with node, java, dotnet, or go keys. Innermost value wins per key.

custom_installs.description: Non-apt tools (e.g. helm, golangci-lint) installed via arbitrary shell commands, applied unconditionally at build time.

name.description: Identifier for this install; unique across all merged .agenticrc.toml layers. Shown as a comment in the generated RUN and in `agentic config`.

run.description: Shell commands run as-is, in declaration order, in one Docker RUN layer per entry.

extra_mounts.description: Extra mounts passed to `docker run`. Bind: host/path:container/path. Named volume: name:container/path. Supports ~, $HOME, $TOOL_HOME, $CONTAINER_HOME, $PWD.

read_only_mounts.description: Sub-paths to force read-only even when their parent mount is writable. Format: host/path:container/path, or a bare sub/path shorthand relative to the workspace.

secrets.description: Files to mount read-only into the container. Format: name:/path/to/file[:/container/path]. Defaults to /run/secrets/<name>.

env.description: Environment variables to set in the container. Format: KEY=VALUE, or bare KEY to forward the host's current value.

check_updates.description: Periodically check upstream for a newer tool version during `agentic run` and offer to update. Default: true.

enabled.description: Route the tool's egress through the allowlist proxy. Default: false.

mode.description: "enforce" blocks disallowed hosts; "monitor" logs the allowlist verdict without blocking anything. Setting mode = "monitor" implies the proxy is enabled, unless enabled = false is also set. Default: enforce.

allowed_hosts.description: Extra hosts to permit, merged on top of the tool's baseline. Exact match, or a leading-dot / *. entry to match a domain and all its subdomains.

instructions.description: Environment instructions written into each tool's global instructions file.

enabled.description: Write the generated environment-instructions block. Default: true.

custom.description: Free text appended after the generated sections. Accumulates across RC layers (outermost first, separated by a blank line).

marketplaces.description: Git-based plugin marketplaces (skills, agents, commands, hooks, MCP servers) to sync onto the host and mount read-only into every applicable tool's container.

name.description: Identifier for this marketplace; becomes a container mount path segment. Not required to be globally unique.

url.description: Git URL to clone (anything `git clone` accepts - https://, git@host:..., etc).

tools.description: Tool names this marketplace is mounted into (currently claude, copilot - opencode has no marketplace support). Omit to mount into every tool that supports marketplaces.
